historical_record.description: On 17 January 1990 a city building inspector cited Hastings College of the Law, the owner, for conditions at the residential hotel at 260 McAllister Street: plaster missing from halls and rooms, a garbage chute that did not work, broken windows and a leaking roof.

This was one of five buildings bought by Hastings College of the Law in 1972 for a planned law center. Residents were formally notified in 1977, and in 1982 a court found that the school had ignored state relocation law in displacing tenants.
